verdict.rationale: BugSnag's first-party docs describe BugSnag On-premise as a self-hosted version of the core product that organizations can run in their own PCI- or HIPAA-compliant environments, which directly delivers the story. The evidence is a single short docs mention, so the depth of this capability is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: installation/deployment documentation, licensing or plan requirements, feature parity with the cloud version, and independent or hands-on corroboration of on-premise deployments.
